# Implementation Readiness Checklist: Grammar Vertical Slice

**Purpose**: Assess whether the Grammar Vertical Slice requirements are complete, unambiguous, architecture-aligned, and ready for task generation and PR review.
**Created**: 2026-10-10
**Feature**: [Grammar Vertical Slice specification](../spec.md)

**Note**: This custom checklist is generated by the `$speckit-checklist` command based on feature context and requirements.
**Review Ownership**: This checklist is a reviewer-owned requirements-quality review artifact. Mark an item `[x]` only when the reviewer determines the requirements-quality criterion is satisfied.
**Marker Semantics**: `[x]` means the criterion has been reviewed and satisfied for requirements quality. It does not mean implementation work is complete.

## Requirements Completeness

- [x] CHK001 Are requirements and acceptance scenarios defined for every transition in the primary flow from Home through topic and lesson selection, exercise submission, feedback, and the next sentence? [Completeness, Spec §User Stories 1–3, Spec §FR-001–FR-005]
- [x] CHK002 Are alternate and recovery requirements complete for correct feedback, incorrect feedback, Fix, Next, feedback minimization/reopening, grading cancellation, and the final sentence? [Scenario Coverage, Spec §FR-013–FR-017, Spec §FR-023–FR-024]
- [x] CHK003 Are duplicate submission, cancellation, and late grading-result semantics stated precisely enough to determine which response and progress state remain authoritative? [Clarity, Edge Case, Spec §FR-008–FR-009, Plan §State machine]
- [x] CHK004 Are data-availability requirements complete for populated catalogs, empty topic and lesson collections, unavailable identifiers, and the minimum authored topic/lesson/exercise set? [Coverage, Spec §FR-021, Spec §Assumptions, Tasks T010–T017]
- [x] CHK005 Are grading normalization rules exhaustive and unambiguous for case, leading/trailing whitespace, repeated internal whitespace, punctuation, word order, Unicode text, and accepted alternatives? [Clarity, Edge Case, Spec §FR-010–FR-012, Tasks T013/T017]
- [x] CHK006 Is the boundary between localized EN/VI product chrome and unchanged authored English lesson content defined for every picker, list, exercise, loading, feedback, empty, and unavailable state? [Completeness, Consistency, Spec §FR-018, Plan §Localization and adaptive behavior]
- [x] CHK007 Are the final-sentence outcome and all excluded completion, reward, persistence, authentication, payment, AI, and backend behaviors mutually consistent across scope, functional requirements, and success criteria? [Consistency, Spec §FR-022–FR-023, Spec §SC-009]
- [x] CHK008 Does the specification state whether local catalog or grading operations can fail unexpectedly and, if so, define the error and recovery requirements; otherwise, is their infallibility documented as an assumption? [Gap, Exception Flow, Spec §FR-024, Spec §Assumptions, Plan §Grammar-specific code]
- [x] CHK009 Can every functional requirement be traced to at least one independently reviewable acceptance scenario or measurable success criterion, including cancellation, empty states, localization, and final-sentence behavior? [Traceability, Measurability, Spec §FR-001–FR-024, Spec §SC-001–SC-009, Tasks T001–T046]

## Design-System Reuse

- [x] CHK010 Is every Grammar surface and state mapped to the required canonical components—TopicCard, LessonCard/Grammar, ProgressStepper/Grammar, SourceTextCard/Sentence, AnswerInput, SubmitButton, HintChipBar, ExerciseTemplate, and all three FeedbackSheet variants? [Completeness, Spec §FR-006, Plan §Reusable design-system surface]
- [x] CHK011 Are the required states and responsibilities of each reused component specified clearly enough to distinguish component behavior from Grammar screen composition? [Clarity, Spec §FR-006–FR-017, Plan §Reusable design-system surface, Tasks T003–T007/T020–T022]
- [x] CHK012 Is the prohibition on canonical component duplication explicit for visual copies, feature-local wrappers that reproduce component behavior, and Grammar-specific forks of shared components? [Clarity, Architecture Boundary, Spec §FR-006, Plan §Reusable design-system surface]
- [x] CHK013 Are all proposed design-system extensions identified as narrow, additive, backward-compatible changes with clear ownership and no Grammar domain semantics leaking into shared APIs? [Completeness, Consistency, Plan §Reusable design-system surface, Tasks T003–T007]
- [x] CHK014 Is the GrammarCorrect requirement for a visible but disabled AI-analysis action reconciled explicitly with the canonical FeedbackSheet contract and its current variants? [Conflict, Spec §FR-013, Plan §Reusable design-system surface, Tasks T001/T006]
- [x] CHK015 Is the requirement to update canonical design-system documentation or tokens before dependent Flutter APIs stated for every identified contract gap? [Dependency, Plan §Reusable design-system surface, Tasks T001–T002]
- [x] CHK016 Is the minimum loading duration tied to a named canonical motion token, with a documented requirements path if no 300 ms token currently exists? [Clarity, Dependency, Spec §FR-009, Plan §Reusable design-system surface, Task T002]
- [x] CHK017 Are canonical background/foreground palette pairing, typography, spacing, radii, breakpoints, motion, focus, and state-token requirements defined without allowing feature-local arbitrary values? [Coverage, Consistency, Spec §FR-007/FR-019–FR-020, Plan §Localization and adaptive behavior]
- [x] CHK018 Are conditional shared additions such as PagerDots/Lesson, reusable empty-state treatment, instruction slots, focus handles, and adaptive sheet constraints resolved as mandatory, excluded, or contingent on a clearly stated requirement? [Ambiguity, Plan §Reusable design-system surface, Tasks T003–T007]

## Architecture Boundaries

- [x] CHK019 Are ownership and dependency requirements explicit for Grammar, Writing, app routing, design_system, core, localization, and generated API code, including the prohibition on Grammar importing Writing internals? [Completeness, Plan §Constitution Check/Structure Decision, Tasks T023/T024/T043]
- [x] CHK020 Are Grammar domain requirements constrained to pure Dart concepts without Flutter, Riverpod, routing, localization, JSON, storage, platform, or generated-client dependencies? [Architecture Boundary, Plan §Grammar-specific code, Tasks T010–T012/T043]
- [x] CHK021 Is the Grammar repository contract defined as the source-of-truth boundary for catalog retrieval, lesson retrieval, exercise lookup, and deterministic grading, with presentation isolated from data implementation details? [Completeness, Plan §Grammar-specific code, Tasks T011/T017–T018]
- [x] CHK022 Is deterministic in-memory grading explicitly limited to this client-only slice while production grading remains backend-owned, with no conflicting implication that client grading becomes production authority? [Consistency, Spec §FR-010, Plan §Grammar-specific code, Tasks T011/T017]
- [x] CHK023 Is the sealed workflow state model complete for editing, grading, correct feedback, incorrect feedback, cancellation, retry/fix, reopening, progression, and terminal return, without mutually exclusive boolean states? [Completeness, Consistency, Plan §State machine, Tasks T012/T014/T019/T029]
- [x] CHK024 Are requirements for stale request identity, duplicate interaction handling, cancellation, and exactly-once progression precise enough to preserve deterministic state transitions? [Clarity, Edge Case, Spec §FR-008–FR-009/FR-016/FR-024, Plan §State machine]
- [x] CHK025 Are typed-route ownership, route parameters, invalid topic/lesson/exercise handling, stable semantic routes, and final return behavior documented consistently across specification and plan? [Completeness, Consistency, Spec §FR-001–FR-004/FR-021/FR-023, Plan §Routing]
- [x] CHK026 Are exclusions against new dependencies, premature application/use-case layers, generic shared Exercise domain abstractions, Base* abstractions, persistence, and sensitive answer logging explicit and mutually consistent? [Boundary, Spec §FR-022, Plan §Grammar-specific code/Notes, Tasks T017/T043]
